FCO2 source	FCO2 estimated (1) and gridded (2)	---	Gridded FCO2 data was estimated with Wanninkhof 1992. The uncertainties were 20% with the first one according to Wanninkhof (2014). https://aslopubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/pdf/10.4319/lom.2014.12.351											
Day	Day of month	---												
Month	Month	---												
Year	Year	---												
Long	Longitude 	West Degrees												
Lat	Latitude	North Degrees												
SST (°C)	Sea Surface Temperature	Degrees												
SSS	Sea Surface Salinity	dimensionless												
pCO2W (µatm)	Partial presure of CO2 in the ocean	 (µatm)	"Gridded pCO2 was a product of thousands of measurements of this variable for almost three decades (Takahashi et al., 2014). "											
pCO2A (µatm)	Partial presure of CO2 in the atmosphere	 (µatm)	"Represents the monthly average, varying each year. The values where obteined from https://scrippsco2.ucsd.edu/data/atmospheric_co2/primary_mlo_co2_record.html (Dr. Keeling)"											
∆pCO2 (µatm)	Difference between pCO2W minus pCO2A	 (µatm)												
Wind (m s-1)	Wind magnitude	(m s-1)	"https://psl.noaa.gov/data/gridded/data.ncep.reanalysis.html (Kalnay et al., 1996)"											
FCO2   (mmol C m-2 d-1)	Carbon fluxes between air-sea  estimated with Wanninhkof (2014) coefficient. 	mmol C m-2 d-1
